cases.question: Which set of datasets do they use?

prompt_addendum: Combine closely related requested facts into a concise claim when they share supporting evidence, so a shared passage need not be cited repeatedly. Prefer the smallest sufficient set of provided evidence IDs for each claim; preserve all information required by the question and all material qualifications.
scope: Known regression case; selector uses source, exact question and initial ranges only. Explicit cues chosen after observing prior failure; not blind validation.
stop_rule: No repair, retry, budget increase or case substitution. Failed generation skips review.
acceptance: Report selection of conditional evidence separately from generation coverage and citation fidelity. No claim of global completeness.
